calibration_cascade.title: Calibration Cascade
calibration_cascade.summary: Dependency graph connecting the master constant, neutron-mass anchor, dimensionless couplings, mass-ratio chain, G-alpha bridge, SI readouts, prediction catalogue, falsification surfaces, Registry items, TauLib modules, and manuscript source chapters.
calibration_cascade.boundary_statement: The prediction catalogue lists claims; the constants ledger is a table of outputs; the Calibration Cascade records dependency and verification structure.
calibration_cascade.metrology_note: Book IV/V numerical comparisons remain labelled as CODATA 2018. Current NIST CODATA 2022 and BIPM SI links are recorded as comparison and unit-realization guardrails, not as recalculated Corpus claims.
